recommended_fixes: Updated PHP extension installation order: non-dom extensions (fileinfo, ctype, iconv, mbstring, zip) installed first, then dom-dependent extensions (dom, xml, xmlreader, xmlwriter, simplexml) installed together at the end

buildability_assessment.approach: PHP extensions installed in a single RUN command with non-dom extensions first, then dom-dependent extensions together at the end: docker-php-source extract && docker-php-ext-install fileinfo ctype iconv mbstring zip && docker-php-ext-configure gd --with-freetype --with-jpeg && docker-php-ext-install gd && docker-php-ext-install dom xml xmlreader xmlwriter simplexml && docker-php-source delete
buildability_assessment.review_notes: Dockerfile syntax valid, build context files present, system libraries match Debian bookworm base, script paths consistent, workspace contract respected, verifier assets separated. PHP extensions installed in a single RUN command with docker-php-source kept extracted. Non-dom extensions (fileinfo, ctype, iconv, mbstring, zip, gd) are installed first, then dom-dependent extensions (dom, xml, xmlreader, xmlwriter, simplexml) are installed together at the end. This avoids docker-php-ext-install cleaning up dom headers before xmlreader compiles. docker-php-source delete runs only at the very end. System libraries (libpng-dev, libjpeg62-turbo-dev, libfreetype-dev, libzip-dev, libonig-dev, libxml2-dev) installed first for GD, ZIP, mbstring, and XML extension compilation.

notes: PHP extensions are now installed in a single RUN command with non-dom extensions first, then dom-dependent extensions together at the end: docker-php-source extract && docker-php-ext-install fileinfo ctype iconv mbstring zip && docker-php-ext-configure gd --with-freetype --with-jpeg && docker-php-ext-install gd && docker-php-ext-install dom xml xmlreader xmlwriter simplexml && docker-php-source delete. This approach addresses the issue where docker-php-ext-install cleans up after each extension internally - by installing dom-dependent extensions (dom, xml, xmlreader, xmlwriter, simplexml) together at the end, dom headers remain available for xmlreader compilation.
